data.one_liner: Calculate the difference between two lists as a list of edit operations.
data.what_it_does: Calculates the difference (edit script) between two lists using the Myers diff algorithm. It returns operations like insert, remove, change, and move to transform one list into another.
use_when: You need to animate the insertion, removal, or reordering of items in a list without managing a StatefulWidget
You receive a whole new list of data from an endpoint and need to compute the delta updates
avoid_when: You are using a state management framework that already handles list diffing internally
You only need simple list comparison without granular edit operations
strengths: Efficient Myers algorithm implementation with O(N) space and O(N + D^2) time performance
Supports custom equality checks, move detection, and batching of insert/remove operations
Provides updates with concrete data items via getUpdatesWithData()
weaknesses: Move detection increases time complexity to O(N^2)
Requires manual application of the returned edit operations to your UI or data structures
